primary_early_schedule.note: This is already a zero-observation-cost hindsight upper bound. Real STOP/CONTINUE probes can only add Target cost and cannot increase this final-context ceiling.

call_and_compute_gates.reason: The optimistic no-observation-cost bound already fails two necessary gates; additional calls cannot rescue them.

decision_reason: Against the prescribed early fixed schedule, even a free clairvoyant stopper saves only 4.52% cumulative context (<5%), and only 2/5 anchors have at least 10% earlier-success opportunity. Training an output-only stopper cannot repair an insufficient opportunity ceiling.

next_contract_change.name: C1-OBS_NATIVE_TARGET_CONFIDENCE
next_contract_change.scope: Allow read-only native token log-probability/margin traces from the frozen Target while retaining lossless source text, V8 ordering, add-only prefixes, and the same fidelity metric.
next_contract_change.why: Existing output-only answer-count, answer-stability, linear-answer, semantic-critic, and self-report probes failed. Native confidence is the smallest information-contract change that directly targets missing observability; cost optimization or more output features cannot enlarge the early schedule's opportunity ceiling.
